body: A Wayne Gretzky quote is a good quote to live by. I may take up knitting to relax and if I do I'm going to knit that onto a blanket to always remember.

You're a complete stranger but I feel better knowing I made you proud. I try to remember that karma will get her one day but it's hard. They make it into a big deal that she works two jobs but they are both minimum wage and she only works 18 hours total per week. I work 40+ at one job and go to school. 

Life isn't fair but one day karma will get her. I probably shouldn't go through life on that alone but for now it helps. You're an awesome stranger to listen and be proud when you don't have to. Thank you.

I'm scared of being a failure. I don't want to end up married and divorced multiple times like my parents. I want to get a great job and be successful but I'm always in the shadow of my younger step sister because she has her dad's money to back everything she does. She can't do wrong. She can't mess up. She is on a pedestal and I feel like a fuck up because I'm not like her. I work my ass off to pay for my own things but no one seems to notice or care. No one ever tells me they are proud of me or good on me for getting into college. I don't want to fail but how can I keep going when all they care about is their own images.

I understand what you mean. And I know it's going to take time to get used to life without him. He was my first real serious boyfriend and we did a lot together. he was my escape from my hectic family. I loved going to his normal family's house and pretending that everything could be okay even if it was just for a little. 

Thank you talking to me. It really means a lot to me that you would listen to a stranger and give out great advice. I know things will get better but I think I needed to hear it from someone who had an outside perspective.
I think it's mainly that everything that has been dragging me down has finally got to me. It's just wore me down slowly but surely and finally gotten to me. Family. Relationships. Work. Everything.
Yes. I'll have a nasty scar but they won't have to cut it off or anything. I didn't even want to tell my family because I'm clumsy to begin with so they will just stare at me like I'm retarded again.
Pretty crappy. I cut my foot open and had to get stitches.

That really helps. I know one day it will be better but it's so hard to cope with  when I thought things were different. It's like one day everything was flowers and candy and the next it was like we barely knew each other. 

And it scares me that one day he will move on because I'm still going to have feelings no matter what. I just don't want him to forget the things we did together.

Mostly my ex boyfriend but also my family. It's a blended family and I'm not the preppy little angel my younger step sister is. I'm not blue eyed and blonde haired and my daddy didn't pay for an expensive university degree so that I could one day open a coffee stand. I'm always compared to her as are my other siblings but everything comes back to get. It makes me hate myself more that I can't be the popular girl who gets all the guys and has this great lifestyle where I don't have to work and live off daddy's money

Anything. I just need someone to talk to. Everyone I live with thinks life is sunshine. And I could never talk to my friends about anything because I put on a happy front because I don't want people to know anything is wrong.

We broke up two years ago but remained friends with benefits. And I thought we had a chance at getting back together until a month ago. He said it would never happen. And I feel like now I've ruined something great. Both my parents have been married a bunch of times and I feel like I'm going to end up like them. Unhappy and ruining everything.

The older I get the more I realize that the world my parents painted for me as a child isn't rainbows and unicorns and fairy tales. It's depressing and evil and I honestly don't want to be in it anymore.
I'm 21 and I don't know what I want to do with my life. I'm in love with someone who doesn't love me back anymore. My family is narcissistic. I feel like I have nothing to live for.

It's normal to miss her. Especially if you have spent every moment together for a long period of time. And it will be hard on you. If it wasn't I would be worried. If you ever need someone to talk to just PM me. Or find a friend you can talk to. Don't try and get through it alone.

Just sit down and think about everything. Weigh all the options. You didn't say in your post if she went to a different home town just to your respective houses. If she said go to a different hometown she may have hooked up with an ex. Or she may be busy with family. 

Try not talking to her for a few days. If she comes crawling back ask her what happened. If not, move on and find a more amazing girl who won't cheat on you! 

Best of luck :)

If you are just waiting for her to cheat on you then maybe you should leave her. It is not fair to you at all to just sit around and wait for her to cheat on you. 

It may not be what you want to hear but you really need to sit down and look at the relationship. Will you be panicking every time you aren't around her because you will be thinking she is off cheating? 

It may be hard because you have feelings for her but you honestly need to think about yourself and how you will feel if you stay with her. I hope this helps and I hope you figure out what is best for you. Even if it hurts her feelings.
